summary.text: Dang Hun Luo Po Seal is Fang Yuan's immortal killer move that uses Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po Valley as its cores.

claims.text: Inside the sovereign immortal aperture, Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po Valley buzz and shake slightly as they resonate. Fang Yuan pushes his palm, and a grey-white square seal flies out. Wherever it passes, souls disintegrate into ashes. A large area of the soul beast army is cleared, and even immemorial soul beasts have no resistance. Most soul path killer moves are greatly suppressed in front of this seal. Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s breath turns rough, and for the first time since the battle started he stops his tsunami-like attacks.

He says he did not deduce the road of life, and gained Dang Hun Luo Po Seal instead. Its foundation is the Luo Po seal he created before. It was developed from the foundation of soul path and suppresses that path. He says it is a pity he only has the two sacred lands; if he had Pacifying Soul Lake as well, he might restrain all soul path methods completely.

Dang Hun Luo Po Seal is a pure soul path killer move, amplified in the Door of Life and Death. The soul path dao marks it leaves behind are like the winds of Luo Po Valley and the vibration force of Dang Hun Mountain, and they make it difficult for soul beasts to condense into being. Immortal Zombie Giant Sun analyzes that although Spectral Soul Demon Venerable is a Dao Lord who can amplify himself here and suppress Fang Yuan’s Dang Hun Luo Po seal, his state of mind is not clear, so Dang Hun Luo Po seal can also receive amplification.

Dang Hun Luo Po Seal is a killer weapon against Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, who has lost his sanity. Zhan Bu Du’s view is that there is a possibility of relying on it to kill Spectral Soul Demon Venerable.

Fang Yuan does not activate Dang Hun Luo Po Seal. Information about the move has already been transmitted from the Door of Life and Death. Star Constellation Immortal Venerable is slightly disappointed that he does not use this method.

Fang Yuan uses Dang Hun Luo Po Seal to make an excuse for Giant Sun Immortal Venerable and the rest, while a separate killer move with Dang Hun Mountain, Luo Po Valley, and Reverse Flow River as the cores forms a road of life out of the Door of Life and Death. After Spectral Soul Demon Venerable flies out, Fang Yuan activates Dang Hun Luo Po Seal again. One attack severs a thousand of Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s arms.

Shen Cong Sheng asks how Fang Yuan got so many new killer moves. In that question he names Dang Hun Luo Po Seal and lists Dang Hun Mountain, Luo Po Valley, and Reverse Flow River as what it made use of. He then sets that name apart from the killer move that let Fang Yuan leave the Door of Life and Death, which he says used the three secluded domains of heaven and earth as the cores.
